fields.description: Issue includes editorials and political commentary focused on Florida and Dade County primary campaigns, including support for Governor John W. Martin in opposition to Park Trammell for U.S. Senate and extensive coverage of the Dade County sheriff’s race (including discussion of prohibition enforcement and bootlegging). Contains a published letter to depositors from J. E. Lummus of The Southern Bank & Trust Company regarding a dividend and certificates of deposit. Reports and promotional coverage include a juvenile movie-impersonation contest at the Roney Plaza Casino (Miami Beach) with newsreel filming, local civic and convention notes (Elks), and assorted local items, advertisements, and entertainment/sports notices.
